2026

Active HAB Reports

Mountain View Pond, Gardnerville, NV

Mountain View Pond in Gardnerville, NV has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 10/14/2026 following visual observation of a surface bloom. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

Lahontan Reservoir

On 11/2/26 the Lahontan Reservoir advisory level has been lowered from a HAB Danger to a HAB Warning based on the most current data and observations collected by NDEP. The conditions of the waterbody are still considered unsafe for human and animal exposure. Contact with water is strongly discouraged.

To view the previous NDSP press release regarding the 9/9/2026 HAB Danger, click here.

Lake Mohave including Placer Cove, Eagle Wash, and Cottonwood Cove

Lake Mohave has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 6/11/2026 following visual observation and satellite imaging of a surface bloom. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

Eagle Wash and Placer Cove have been downgraded to a HAB Watch advisory effective 09/09/2026 following visual observation. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

Cottonwood Cove has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 10/28/2026 following visual observation. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

Virginia Lake

Virginia Lake has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 6/23/2026 following visual observation and satellite imaging of a surface bloom. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

South Meadows Community Pond

South Meadows Community Pond has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 6/23/2026 following visual observation. People and pets should avoid contact with the water. This suspected HAB is located in a pond on private property (with general public access) so will not be found on the State OSE-HAB dashboard.

Walker Lake

On 5/19/26 the Walker Lake HAB advisory level has been lowered from a HAB Warning to a HAB Watch based on the most current data and observations collected by NDEP. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.
